name: browsers
description: Drive Firefox, Zen, and Safari from the terminal — open pages, read and drive them, and take screenshots. Firefox and Zen run as isolated headless instances over Marionette; Safari runs in its own automation window over safaridriver.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Firefox, Zen, and Safari from the terminal.
interface.longDescription: Open, read, and drive web pages in Firefox, Zen, or Safari — navigation, script evaluation, clicks, typing, waits, and screenshots. Firefox and Zen run as isolated headless instances over Gecko's Marionette protocol; Safari runs in an isolated automation window over the safaridriver that ships with macOS.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this page breaks in Safari.
Fill the login form in Zen and tell me what happens.
